admission.justification: Member of the selected-task-chat family: without the display-evidence gate the joint appearance promise fails. It guards the exact D153 failure: acknowledging a chat as shown when no screen displays leaves an endless loading with no named problem.

applicability: Every selection that asks the framed Paseo application to show an agent — the master, a task, or a role under a task — on document and Chats pages alike.
conditions: The bridge holds an unanswered open for the requested agent in the current generation.
The frame's application reports through the standard channel (ready, shown, error).
The workspace under test comes from the host's agent record, not the incoming message.
exclusions: Documents without a live agent, which show the launcher per MIK-R95.

evidence: successor report 260928-MIK-L121-worker-R4-MIK-R121-v1.md; paseoPluginClient.test.ts (52+2 new: contradicting-strip silence, native scroll literal acceptance); focused-vitests-r4 log 118 pass; evidence dir phase1-r4-probe-record.md P1

statement: An open of agent A confirms only when the frame route names the host-record workspace as exact path segments, the stored layout under the exact <server>:<workspace> key names agent_<A> as the shown pane's focused tab, no visible aria-selected agent tab names another agent, and a chat scroll root matching the agent-chat-scroll- prefix (id or test id, either bundle literal or runtime variant) is visibly mounted with no visible loading/not-found marker; any miss fails closed with no fallback.
